output.reason: The points layer has no CRS, so its projected-looking coordinates cannot be compared reliably with the zones’ longitude/latitude coordinates for a spatial join.
Contradictory distance constraints: max_distance is 5 km while min_distance is 10 km.
EPSG:4326 is a geographic CRS whose planar coordinate units are degrees, so a projected planar distance in meters cannot be computed in this CRS. Specify a suitable projected CRS.
Dissolved 300 m buffers, reprojected to longitude/latitude; polygon boundaries are represented by rounded coordinates.
The target CRS EPSG:999999 is not a recognized coordinate reference system.

limitations: Small synthetic fixtures; they test operation correctness, not scale or real-world data quality.
Expected outputs come from one reference workflow (Shapely, pyproj, GEOS, PROJ); an error shared by those libraries would not be caught.
Tolerances are set per case and stated in explicit units, sized to catch the smallest error of the mistake each case targets; none is tighter than a correct answer given to 5 decimal places needs.

benchmark.notes: Every expected output is computed by reference.py; regenerate them with `geoevals bench regenerate gis_correctness`.
